verdict.rationale: Anytype has a local API that uses keys: the OpenAPI spec mentions keys that can be missing, unknown, revoked or expired. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped or limited, whether per space, read-only or per operation. Having API keys and calling the agent toolkit 'safe' are related features, not documented least-privilege credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
